svg.text: ACT-09 | Detect, retain, then isolate the physical output
Proposed architecture | No native amendment | Missing QUAL_OK / ACK sources stay disabled
Finite observer power does not guarantee disable through an indefinite brownout.
A separate output boundary must take over before the stored energy expires. No circuit is accepted here.
Main +3V3: sense upstream
Keep actual UV / OV observation.
A short must not drain held storage.
Proposed reverse-blocked island
Reference, observer and fault memory
Independent guard starts reference.
Charge, OV and input paths: OPEN
Blocking is not OV protection.
All injected current needs bounds.
1. Detect before validity is lost
Declared amplitude, duration and slew
Sense / reference / supply applicability
Fast inhibit is a separate path.
400 ns is an allocation, not a guarantee.
2. Retain a detected fault
Keep clear through reference changes.
Fresh healthy epoch after each loss
QUAL release -> guard -> ACK
ACK with ARM low -> guard -> ARM
3. Establish physical disable
U14 remains on original main +3V3.
Do not clamp its push-pull output.
Isolate invalid drive before TXU OE.
Retain R40; exact circuit still OPEN.
Same-rail observation deadline
400 ns zero-margin ceiling: 0.167345 V/us
This ceiling is not a held-island guarantee.
Held island: a finite handover interval
100 us handover budget; fast inhibit is still separate.
Zero-margin effective C: 4.457 uF
ESR, leakage, load and final disable remain unqualified.
Explorer: startup, bounce, held ACK, conflicting edges, unknown receiver and guard loss
All displayed states are requests. Unknown inputs block qualification; timing conflicts invalidate the trace.
Next circuit task: exact U14-to-TXU0102 permission boundary under partial power.
Then close island charging, reverse blocking, overvoltage and reference shutdown before native insertion.
